module: Flowgraph node "Can Enter From Walking" (category repeat_instant, depends on gameplay_walk). Checks that the player is walking and is near a stopped vehicle they can enter. Outputs: canEnter (flow), vehId (nearest vehicle or nil), closeButNotStopped (hidden flow, vehicle nearby but moving).

work.desc: Uses gameplay_walk.isWalking, getVehicleInFront and isAtParkingSpeed to fill the output pins.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays a green vehicle icon if entering is possible.
